author: namanbansal580
name: animated-feature-cards
description: Animated feature cards are interactive UI components that highlight key features or services of a product using motion effects. They typically include an icon or image, a title, and a brief description, and animate (e.g., slide, fade, zoom, flip) when hovered over or scrolled into view. These cards enhance user engagement and improve visual appeal by making the content more dynamic and noticeable.
